DARK is developing a solution to debris proliferation in orbit: Interceptor, an end-to-end solution capable of performing emergency debris removal missions.

Interceptor is designed to reach any point in space in less than 24 hours to perform critical operations such as debris capture and controlled destructive deorbiting.

Through a platformized approach, Dark will be able to transpose Interceptor's performance to transversal markets such as Active Debris Removal, payload delivery, reactive launches or hypersonic experiments.
The multiplication of addressable markets with the Interceptor platform will lead to a drastic cost reduction for all these services, thus increasing the competitiveness of the European space ecosystem.

entityDescription:
Using satellite data and artificial intelligence to monitor and manage offsetting projects, Tracks CO2 drives positive environmental impact and market transparency.

Tracks CO2 is formed by a group of a multidisciplinary team whose members have extensive experience in business, digital transformation, innovation, and specifically in telecommunications engineering. Currently, the main project manager is Teresa Domenech (CEO), who is 100% dedicated to this project. She graduated in Telecommunications Engineering and has a Master Degree in Telecommunications with specialization in machine learning and deep learning, which is the technology on which the development of the AI ​​model for carbon sequestration is based.
The tech team consists of Isabel Manresa and Sara Martínez, both telecommunication engineers specialized in remote sensing and AI.
The company also has the support of Saul Garcia, Tomas Terradas and Rafael Terradas who have a partial dedication to the project, more focused on the commercial field and on raising financing that can help accelerate the development of the product and technology. 
Their profiles and professional contacts are vitally important for the company to generate new commercial leads, but also to seek new sources of private financing to materialize our vision. 
As the company obtains new sources of financing and/or clients, it intends to grow the team in a sustained manner and make them part of the project through the transfer of phantom shares.The company also has an expert advisory team that help the company grow and expand; it includes the collaboration of Carlos Lopez, Ph.D. from the Universidad Politecnica de Catalunya, specialized in remote sensing and Earth observation, who is part of the research centers RSLAB - Grupo de Investigacion en Teledeteccion and the CommSensLab-UPC - Center UPC Communication and Detection Research Specific.Therefore, we have the perfect mix between relevant academic background and great motivation to lead a project that aims to contribute to the fight against climate change.With this team, Tracks CO2 intends to position itself as the most accurate tool for emissions offsetting investments, using Satellite Technology and Artificial Intelligence.

entityDescription:
CMP Composites is a new and innovative company operating in the field of composite materials. Since its creation in 2016, it has been offering its customers the development of solutions to achieve different objectives for their structures or components ; the manufacturing of prototype parts (from a few grams to a couple of metric tonnes), the optimisation of mass, of their thermomechanical resistance, of their cost or finally their environmental footprint. On the scale of technological maturity, CMP Composites is able to lead projects from very low levels of maturity (TRL1) to technological demonstrator (TRL6).
Depending on their customer needs and the type of application, CMP can also offer serial manufacture (TRL9) or perform technology transfer.
The company relies on its design office made up of doctors and engineers specialized in the design and simulation of composite structures. Its close link with the workshop enables the manufacture prototypes using processes such as infusion, RTM, prepreg molding and filament winding.

Since 2017, CMP Composites has been supporting CNES in the development of cryogenic fluid storage tanks made of composite materials. These developments have been the subject of two patents and CMP Composites continues to develop its linerless technology. On the basis of this work, new research activities have been initiated with various actors in the "new space" sector, in particular to provide innovative solutions for the fairing or inter-stage skirt.

The Institute of Environmental Protection – National Research Institute (IEP-NRI) is a departmental institute supervised by the Ministry of Climate and Environment. The primary goal of the Institute is to create the scientific basis for environmental protection, to provide knowledge to the governmental and self-governmental administration and economic entities, as well as to raise the level of ecological awareness and shape the ecological attitudes of society.
In its activities the IEP-NRI deals with the following issues:
- Air quality
- Waste management
- Climate change
- Protection of the Earth’s surface
- Protection against noise
- Management of emissions
- Sustainable development
- Eco-toxicology
- Environmental analyses
- Research
- Ecological education
IEP-NRI is the country’s leading scientific and research unit in the field of environmental protection. The Institute’s rank is confirmed by the comprehensive assessment of its scientific and research and development activities for the years 2013-2016, conducted in 2017, in which IEP-NRI was once again awarded scientific category A.
High qualifications, significant activity and commitment of the Institute’s staff, as well as the level of research and development work corresponding to European standards have contributed to the position of a significant research centre both in the domestic scientific community and abroad, as well as a reliable and fully professional partner for the economic environment. The Institute’s laboratory base is equipped with modern research apparatus and the technical infrastructure meets the high requirements necessary to conduct scientific research and development work at the highest world level.

Giri B Karthikeyan: An applied mathematician specialised in the design of intelligent health tech applications.

Babitha Jyoti: An oncologist of high acclaim, who also serves as our Clinical Director.
